title: learned input-gated evidence update (minLSTM-type, match evidence as input) replaces the fixed log-odds time recursion of the champion; builder frozen

a.recipe: gate trainer (new, pattern of p17_gate.py): builder e123_D7_r3_f1 frozen, MinGateCell on the matched nodes, zero-initialised last layer, 1500 steps, lr 1e-3, loss BCE(fused pi, on-lane) + graph_losses on the fused pi; seeds 0 and 1; fallback 2-fold cross-fit over the 22 VAL scenes if the frozen builder is over-confident on TRAIN

c1.recipe: same trainer with two global scalars (a, b) instead of the conditioned gate (equal budget)

c0.recipe: the champion with the fixed rule (a = 0.9, b = 1.0), no training

rule.note: conditioning on the match evidence matters, not only the constants; ms per frame +0.5 at most is checked in the timing run

kill: fixed rule gains less than +0.010 R@1_far over no recursion (step 0); identity test fails; cell stays within 0.05 of its initial weights or mean fused pi of matched nodes > 0.97; after seed 0 of a gain below +0.005 over c0 and below c1
